provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. u_z = q^{-A}U and p = q^{-2A}Π are literal pullback bodies with exactly the exponents -A and -2A. The other two are carried in the Lean's component conventions. The azimuthal field is stored as the swirl coefficient f with exponent -A-1/2 (swirlProfile = pullback h (-A h - 1/2) P.f) because AxisymmetricResidual.velocity encodes the angular velocity as r·F; since r = √(2s) = q^{1/2}√(2X) and E = √(2X)f, this gives u_θ = q^{-A}E, which physical_swirl_value states outright. The radial field is stored as B with u_r = -rB and B = -V/(2s), so r u_r = V = fluxProfile = q^0 · radialFlux(X,η), matching the paper's V_0 with no power of q. The identification of the Lean's P.U, P.f, P.pressure and radialFlux with the paper's U, E, Π, V_0 rests on these exponents and on the file docstrings, not on reading the profile construction.
